content: The executor successfully completed the HWPX template replacement task with a perfect reward (1.0). The strategy of unzipping the HWPX (OOXML-like ZIP structure), performing XML manipulation while handling namespaces, and crucially, removing layout cache elements (e.g., linesegarray) to force the HWP reader to re-render text, is highly effective for this file format. The instruction to use lxml/ElementTree while preserving the XML declaration and directory structure remains a robust pattern for HWPX manipulation tasks.
